suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented radical prostatectomy for prostate cancer and separately documented urinary incontinence developing or materially worsening after surgery. Establish pre-treatment urinary status when available. Do not infer urinary incontinence from prostate cancer itself, and do not use PMID 32680820 alone to generalize this treatment-complication proposition to all prostate-cancer therapies. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

Require documented radical prostatectomy for prostate cancer, separately documented erectile dysfunction developing or materially worsening after treatment, and consideration of pre-treatment erectile function. Do not infer ED from prostate cancer alone. PMID 32680820 does not by itself establish radiotherapy as the cause of an individual patient's ED. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
